target_pattern: Choose subjunctive after uncertainty, negation, emotion, influence, and unknown-reference triggers; choose indicative for known facts and specific references.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one default present tense in every subordinate clause.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish mood depends on certainty and reference type: unknown/desired/emotional/pending contexts activate subjunctive, confirmed facts keep indicative.
target_pattern_formula: emotion/value: me alegra/me molesta/me preocupa que + subjunctive
unknown or non-specific referent: busco/necesito + noun + que + subjunctive
natural_examples: No creo que ella tenga razon.
Necesitamos un tecnico que sepa resolver esto.
Conozco un tecnico que sabe resolver esto.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each sentence in Spanish with the correct mood (subjunctive or indicative).
prompts_en: I do not think she is right.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as directed.
drills: Base: Creo que ella tiene razon. -> make it negative.
Base: Busco un hotel que tiene piscina. -> make the clause non-specific and correct mood.
Base: Conozco a alguien que puede ayudarte. -> change to question with unknown person.
Base: Me alegra que estes aqui. -> change emotion to me molesta and make it negative in subordinate clause.
Base: No pienso que esto sea urgente. -> change to affirmative certainty.
Base: Necesitamos un profesor que hable ingles. -> change required language to frances.
Base: Te llamo en cuanto pueda. -> change to nosotros.
Base: Siempre salgo cuando termina la reunion. -> change to future pending event.
Base: Prefiero salir antes de que empiece a llover. -> same subject simplification.
Base: En caso de que necesites ayuda, llamame. -> change helper to nosotros.
Base: No hay duda de que ella trabaja mucho. -> change to no creo que and adjust mood.
Base: Mi jefe insiste en que lleguemos temprano. -> change subject to tu.
Base: Me preocupa que mi hijo este enfermo. -> change person to mis padres.
Base: Hasta que me digas la verdad, no voy a ayudarte. -> change to ustedes.
Base: Voy a comprar una casa cuando tenga suficiente dinero. -> change subject to ella.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the option that matches the intended meaning.
prompts: I do not think he is at home. (No creo que esta en casa. vs No creo que este en casa.)
It is true that we live here. (Es cierto que vivamos aqui. vs Es cierto que vivimos aqui.)
I am looking for someone who can translate this. (Busco alguien que puede traducir esto. vs Busco alguien que pueda traducir esto.)
I know someone who can translate this. (Conozco alguien que pueda traducir esto. vs Conozco alguien que puede traducir esto.)
It bothers me that you do not listen. (Me molesta que no escuchas. vs Me molesta que no escuches.)
There is no doubt that she works hard. (No hay duda de que ella trabaje mucho. vs No hay duda de que ella trabaja mucho.)
As soon as he arrives, we will start. (Tan pronto como llega, empezaremos. vs Tan pronto como llegue, empezaremos.)
Whenever he arrives, he calls me. (Cuando llegue, me llama. vs Cuando llega, me llama.)
Unless you tell me, I will not know. (A menos que me dices, no sabre. vs A menos que me digas, no sabre.)
I prefer to leave before sleeping. (Prefiero salir antes de que me duerma. vs Prefiero salir antes de dormir.)

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish by choosing mood from context, not literal translation.
prompts_en: I doubt they have enough time.
I know a person who can fix this.
I am searching for a person who can fix this.
Tell me as soon as you receive the email.
I always tell you when I receive your email.
It surprises me that he does not want to come.
There is no doubt that she is ready.
I do not think this works.
Before you leave, call me.
Unless we leave now, we will be late.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Negated belief trigger is followed by indicative by default.
Fact statements are overgeneralized to subjunctive.
Unknown reference is treated as known/specific.
Known specific person incorrectly pushed to subjunctive.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Conozco a alguien que puede ayudarme.

common_errors.mistake: Me molesta que no pones atencion
common_errors.why_it_happens: Emotion trigger does not activate subjunctive in learner model.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Me molesta que no pongas atencion.

common_errors.mistake: No hay duda de que ella trabaje mucho
common_errors.why_it_happens: Certainty expression is confused with doubt.
common_errors.correct_spanish: No hay duda de que ella trabaja mucho.

common_errors.mistake: Cuando llegue, me llama (habitual meaning intended)
common_errors.why_it_happens: Future/pending and habitual meanings are mixed.

common_errors.mistake: A menos que me dices, no sabre
common_errors.why_it_happens: Set trigger a menos que is not followed by subjunctive.
common_errors.correct_spanish: A menos que me digas, no sabre.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Antes de que is blended with same-subject infinitive pattern.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Antes de dormir (same subject) / antes de que duermas (different subject).
